established_contexts: traffic-light control from catalog cell; pedestrian-facing red and public highway extent require construction review

variable_parameters.name: original_pedestrian_speed_mps
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original 20 Hz body-center displacement-derived speed in m/s after startup; trace-only observation

variable_parameters.name: walk_speed_target_mps
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 0.8 to 1.6 m/s finite engineering requests; original speed is measured separately and no value is a legal permission threshold

variable_parameters.name: other_device_indication
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: none or an independently inventoried NRS 484B.283 pedestrian indication
